sections.Profile:
"Hot & Cold" is a skiing-themed pinball machine produced by the Spanish manufacturer Inder. The game was released in two versions: a single-player electro-mechanical (EM) version in 1976 and a four-player solid-state (SS) version in 1978. Both versions feature two flippers, three pop bumpers, a four-bank drop target, three standup targets, a kick-out hole, and a spinning target.

- Manufacturer: Inder
- Years made: 1976–1978
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
